articles.summary: Hear how members of the SMA community navigate the challenges of living with SMA as they share stories of overcoming adversity, finding strength and embracing hope. The post Believe in What is Possible appeared first on Scholar Rock .
articles.title: Believe in What is Possible

articles.summary: Hear firsthand from members of the SMA community who are pushing past limitations, embracing their abilities, and proving that SMA is just one part of their journey—not the end. These powerful stories remind us that it’s not about what they can’t do—it’s about everything they’re capable of achieving, no matter the challenges.
articles.title: Expanding What is Possible

articles.summary: Watch the SMA community as they share their hopes and excitement for the future, fueled by the potential of groundbreaking treatment. These voices are a powerful reminder that the future is brighter than ever as members of the SMA community embrace the promise of progress and a life full of potential.
articles.title: A Future Full of Possibilities
